data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 inherits SRC_004's adversarial-item requirement, subsuming it: the error-shape discriminator requires the panel's errors to cluster where the checklist's surface proxies fail, which can only be observed where surface and outcome diverge — i.e., on adversarial items; thus SRC_005 does not replace OOD probes but depends on them to produce the divergence pattern. It is refuted if natural-distribution items already exhibit sufficient surface↔outcome decorrelation to reveal the error pattern without adversarial construction.
